CHAPTER.VERS: Praise YAH! Sing unto Jehovah a new song, and His praise in the assembly of saints.
Let Israel rejoice in Him who made them; let the sons of Zion be joyful in their King.
Let them praise His name in the dance; let them make music unto Him with the timbrel and harp.
For Jehovah takes pleasure in His people; He will glorify the lowly with salvation.
Let the saints be joyful in glory; let them shout aloud upon their beds.
Let the exaltation of the Mighty God be in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
to execute vengeance upon the nations, and punishment upon the peoples;
to bind their kings with fetters, and their nobles with bonds of iron;
to execute upon them the judgment that is written; this honor is for all His saints. Praise YAH!
